title: Menemen Scramble
description: A twist on the traditional Turkish dish, this menemen scramble combines the flavors of spices and herbs with a breakfast favorite.

ingredients.name: turkish spice mix
ingredients.notes: or substitute with paprika and cumin

ingredients.name: menemen spice
ingredients.notes: or substitute with cayenne pepper and black pepper

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the menemen spice and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the beaten eggs and scramble until almost set.
Add the umami, turkish spice mix, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the eggs are fully set.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped herbs if desired.
